name: 林祐正
objective:
本課程將以工程資訊管理之觀點，介紹國內外工程資訊管理及營建自動化案例，包含資訊管理程式撰寫及探討資料庫之設計與實作，希望學生能夠由設計一個資訊系統開始，瞭解工程資訊管理系統之基本概念與應用，進而實際開發一個資訊管理系統，其內容包括：營建自動化應用，建築資訊模型應用，國內外工程資訊管理案例探討，工程資訊之分析與設計，資訊管理程式撰寫，資料庫系統之設計與實作，及系統分析與設計等方法。
This course will provide students with the application of engineering information management (EIM) and the practice of construction management system, management information system concept, the introduction of database design, building information management application, web-based system for EIM, integrate construction management information system's introduction, the introduction of construction automation application, AI-based applications for EIM, the future of engineering information management and other special topics.
課程進度(1-16週):
1. Introduction to Engineering Information Management (EIM)
2. AI-based Applications for EIM
3. GenAI-based Applications for EIM
4. Applications of Internet of Things (IOT) for EIM
5. Applications of Cloud-based EIM system
6. Applications of BIM/CIM for EIM
7. The Special Topic for EIM
8. Case Studies
